notes: Owner OD-5. Accepted risk (critique M-09): a client that ignores Link sees 250 of N SKUs with no truncation signal; the cap is disclosed in openapi.yaml and the README.

why.B: Superseded by OD-5: opt-in limit on the unversioned list is now a /v2 extension; the unversioned page is fixed at 250.
why.D: Superseded by OD-5: a default page size is what OD-5 now does on GET /inventory (fixed 250, after only). It was rejected earlier because a spec client would no longer get every SKU; it is accepted now because an unbounded list ran out of memory at 1M SKUs (C-02).
